---

## Mục tiêu Validation

Xác nhận FE và BE tuân thủ đúng contract cho dashboard betting demo, pre-match only, mock credit:
- API schemas khớp chính xác
- Loading/error/success states hoạt động đúng
- Session expiry và refresh flow hoạt động đúng
- Double-submit và idempotency hoạt động đúng
- Odds stale / credit conflict được xử lý đúng

---

## Test Scenarios

### 1. API Contract Tests (BE-only)

#### TC-BE-001: Bootstrap — Happy Path
```
Given: Valid access token
When: GET /api/v1/dashboard/bootstrap
Then:
  - Status: 200
  - Body includes user, wallet, featured_matches, recent_bets, server_time
  - Body does NOT include password hashes, refresh tokens, or internal ledger IDs
```

#### TC-BE-002: Matches List — Happy Path
```
Given: Valid access token
When: GET /api/v1/matches?limit=20&status=OPEN
Then:
  - Status: 200
  - Body includes items, total, cursor, limit
  - Each item matches MatchSummary schema
```

#### TC-BE-003: Match Detail — Not Found
```
Given: Non-existent match UUID
When: GET /api/v1/matches/{match_id}
Then:
  - Status: 404
  - Body: { error: "MATCH_NOT_FOUND" }
```

#### TC-BE-004: Quote Creation — Happy Path
```
Given: Valid access token, OPEN selections, enough credit
When: POST /api/v1/bet-quotes
Then:
  - Status: 201
  - Body includes id, stake_amount, total_odds_decimal, potential_payout, expires_at, selections
  - Quote is persisted with status QUOTED
```

#### TC-BE-005: Quote Creation — Invalid Selections
```
Given: Duplicated or locked selection_id
When: POST /api/v1/bet-quotes
Then:
  - Status: 400 or 404 depending on invalidity
  - Body uses common error format
```

#### TC-BE-006: Quote Creation — Insufficient Credit
```
Given: stake_amount greater than available_credit
When: POST /api/v1/bet-quotes
Then:
  - Status: 409
  - Body: { error: "INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT" }
```

#### TC-BE-007: Bet Placement — Happy Path
```
Given: Valid quote_id and Idempotency-Key
When: POST /api/v1/bets
Then:
  - Status: 201
  - Body includes BetSummary
  - Quote status becomes CONSUMED
  - Wallet credit is updated atomically
```

#### TC-BE-008: Bet Placement — Replay With Same Idempotency Key
```
Given: Same Idempotency-Key and same payload as a prior success
When: POST /api/v1/bets again
Then:
  - Status: 200
  - Body matches original bet response
```

#### TC-BE-009: Bet Placement — Expired Quote
```
Given: Quote past expires_at
When: POST /api/v1/bets
Then:
  - Status: 409
  - Body: { error: "QUOTE_EXPIRED" }
```

#### TC-BE-010: Bets List — Happy Path
```
Given: Valid access token
When: GET /api/v1/bets?limit=20
Then:
  - Status: 200
  - Body includes items, total, cursor, limit
```

#### TC-BE-011: Wallet Summary — Happy Path
```
Given: Valid access token
When: GET /api/v1/wallet/summary
Then:
  - Status: 200
  - Body includes available_credit, reserved_credit, currency_code
```

---

### 2. FE/BE Integration Tests

#### TC-INT-001: Open Dashboard
```
Given: Authenticated browser session
When: Navigate to /dashboard
Then:
  - FE calls /dashboard/bootstrap
  - Skeleton visible while loading
  - Dashboard renders featured matches and wallet summary on success
```

#### TC-INT-002: Browse and Quote
```
Given: User on dashboard with open matches
When:
  1. Open match detail
  2. Select one or more selections
  3. Enter stake_amount
  4. Create quote
Then:
  - Quote preview appears
  - Confirm button enabled only while quote is valid
```

#### TC-INT-003: Place Bet
```
Given: Valid quote on screen
When: User confirms bet
Then:
  - BET request is sent with Idempotency-Key
  - Success toast appears
  - Quote is cleared
  - Wallet and bets list refresh
```

#### TC-INT-004: Session Expiry
```
Given: User on dashboard with expired access token and refresh cookie invalid
When: Any dashboard API returns 401
Then:
  - FE attempts refresh once
  - On refresh failure, redirect to /login?redirect=/dashboard
  - Show message: "Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn"
```

#### TC-INT-005: Odds Stale Conflict
```
Given: User created selection set, then odds change server-side
When: User creates a new quote or places bet
Then:
  - Server returns 409 ODDS_STALE or QUOTE_EXPIRED
  - FE keeps selections visible and prompts re-quote
```

### 3. Response Schema Validation

#### TC-SCHEMA-001: Common Error Format
```javascript
{
  error: "CAPS_SNAKE_CASE",
  message: "string",
  fields: { /* optional */ }
}
```

#### TC-SCHEMA-002: Quote Response Shape
```javascript
{
  id: "uuid",
  user_id: "uuid",
  stake_amount: 100,
  total_odds_decimal: 3.42,
  potential_payout: 342,
  status: "QUOTED",
  expires_at: "ISO8601",
  server_time: "ISO8601",
  selections: []
}
```

#### TC-SCHEMA-003: Bet Response Shape
```javascript
{
  id: "uuid",
  user_id: "uuid",
  bet_quote_id: "uuid",
  stake_amount: 100,
  potential_payout: 342,
  status: "PLACED",
  placed_at: "ISO8601",
  selections: []
}
```

### 4. UX Flow Validation

#### TC-UX-001: Dashboard Loading
```
Given: Slow bootstrap response
Then:
  - Full-page skeleton is visible
  - No broken empty state is shown prematurely
```

#### TC-UX-002: Quote Loading
```
Given: User clicks create quote
Then:
  - Quote button disabled
  - Spinner visible
  - Double submit impossible
```

#### TC-UX-003: Success Feedback
```
Given: Bet placed successfully
Then:
  - Success toast appears
  - Bet slip resets
  - Wallet summary updates
```

#### TC-UX-004: Error Feedback
```
Given: 409 INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT or ODDS_STALE
Then:
  - Inline banner shown near bet slip
  - Confirm action disabled until user resolves issue
```

---

### 5. Edge Case Validation

#### TC-EDGE-001: Duplicate Selections
```
Given: Same selection added twice
When: Creating quote
Then:
  - Client blocks it before request OR server returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
```

#### TC-EDGE-002: Quote Expiration During Idle
```
Given: Quote visible and timer reaches zero
When: User tries to confirm
Then:
  - FE blocks confirm
  - User must create a new quote
```

#### TC-EDGE-003: Match Becomes Closed
```
Given: Match was OPEN when loaded
When: Match closes before quote
Then:
  - Server returns 409 or 404 depending on endpoint context
  - FE refreshes match detail and marks selections stale
```

#### TC-EDGE-004: Rate Limiting
```
Given: User spams quote or bet actions
When: Limit exceeded
Then:
  - Status 429
  - FE respects retry_after_seconds
```
